title: Visit-Usage Share: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Visits Used Before Cancellation (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** When a grooming pass that earned points is cancelled and its unused visits are refunded, a visit-usage share scales the points to reverse, according to the visits used on the pass before it was cancelled. Visits used are the visits purchased on the pass, less the unused visits the refund removed, both as the Tailwise Grooming Salon records show them.

| Visits used before cancellation | Share of the points to reverse that is reversed |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 50% (0.5) |
| 1 | 75% (0.75) |
| none | all of them |

The scaled figure is rounded down to a whole point.

**Examples (hypothetical, 1,170 points to reverse).**

| Pass | Unused visits removed by the refund | Visits used | Points after the share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 3 | 3 | 585 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 3 | 1 | 877 (877.5 rounded down) |
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 3 | 0 | 1,170 |
